text:
Carla: post-deploy smoke for eu-west1 finished but synthetic KV probe is failing on ~5% of hosts, seen as elevated miss-rate and 503s in kvcache-synth and embed-synth dashboards. rolling pin or hold? :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Canary deployment completed for release v2026.03.20. Post-deploy checks: 97/102 hosts OK. 5 hosts failing KV probe. Auto-retries in progress.

Dylan: thanks. can we get a quick list of failing host ids and service patch version? if it's just a node-level regression we can drain and reprovision, if it's model variant change we should pin. :eyes:

Carla: failing hosts: host-eu-12, host-eu-47, host-eu-89, host-eu-91, host-eu-99. All on runtime v2026.03.20-rc3. previous stable is v2026.02.28.

sre-oncall: I'm seeing correlated increase in kvcache miss latency and a small uptick in OOM kill count around 03:22 UTC on those hosts. recommend pausing rollout and pin region to previous stable while we investigate.

Eva: agree with pause. suggestion: pin routing for eu-west1 to v2026.02.28 and shift 10% of traffic to backup model-quantized variant while we triage. That avoids full rollback for customers.

Dylan: command to pin (manual): `deployctl route set --region eu-west1 --service inference-runtime --version v2026.02.28 --until 2026-03-21T04:00:00Z`

Carla: I'll run the pin now and extend the change window by 2 hours. scheduling note: update release notes in the channel thread and add a quick blurb to the customer-facing changelog about temporary pin.

deploy-bot: Running `deployctl route set` on eu-west1... started. ETA ~30s.

deploy-bot: Completed. Routing pinned to v2026.02.28 for eu-west1. Canary rollback not triggered.

sre-oncall: thanks. I'll start collecting heap/metrics dumps from the 5 hosts and run kvcache repro locally. tagging you @Carla @Dylan.

Eva: thumbs up. after triage, if it's kernel-level memory allocation bump we can roll forward a quick patch. leaving an action: triage complete by +45m, plan to either fix-forward or full rollback. :thumbsup:

Carla: noted. updating release notes: "eu-west1 temporarily pinned to v2026.02.28 after post-deploy KV probe anomalies; investigating root cause. No customer impact observed beyond reduced tail throughput for a subset of requests."

Dylan: good. keeping an eye on synthetic dashboards. ping if anyone sees new failures.

sre-oncall: collecting logs -> /var/logs/kvcache/failures/2026-03-20-03_22.tar.gz and uploading to S3: s3://redwood-sre/triage/2123456789-kvprobe.tar.gz

Carla: thanks — will attach to the release thread and ops ticket.

Eva: :white_check_mark:
